scope: Broaden 7G.3d using current primary-source peer code/documentation, clarify native ACAD_TABLE reader/writer roles, and sequence the next implementation-ready checks without changing format-support claims.

method.kind: Official Autodesk DXF references, primary peer repository source/docs and FreeCAD documentation/source
method.sourcePinning: ACadSharp master and FreeCAD main URLs are mutable and were not pinned to a source commit in this pass. ACadSharp v3.8.0 is a separate tagged release; do not transfer master-source findings to that binary without inspection. Any composed peer run must bind exact source/release, package/binary, configuration and route.
method.evidenceRule: A partial peer reader, limited cell-text extraction, format-version matrix, writer callback or successful file open does not establish complete TABLE semantics, graph preservation, rendering, or native CAD acceptance.

evidence.topic: Autodesk TABLE record and graph closure
evidence.observed: The TABLE DXF reference describes ACAD_TABLE as block-reference-derived, with anonymous *T block name, insertion point, TABLESTYLE hard pointer group 342, owning BLOCK_RECORD hard pointer group 343, row/column metadata and repeated cell data.
evidence.planUse: Require entity, backing block, owner, style, handle closure and cell payload before promoting any TABLE output slice; a TABLESTYLE-only emitter does not complete a table.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp current DWG TABLE source path
evidence.observed: The mutable master DWG reader has TableEntity decoding paths for table dimensions/cells/style references and versioned data; source comments include unfinished style-override behavior and fields that are consumed without retention. The release page separately identifies v3.8.0, so mutable-master source is not automatically the released v3.8.0 implementation.
evidence.planUse: Treat the current source as structural discovery only. Pin a release/commit and run only after local parse routes compose; compare fields the peer retains and report its omissions.

evidence.observed: The current writer support predicate groups TableEntity with unsupported types, emits a not-implemented notification, and returns false instead of serializing it.
evidence.planUse: Do not treat ACadSharp as a TABLE DXF output-acceptance oracle. Preserve an explicit unsupported/loss outcome; test that libdxfrw does not report a complete conversion when a TABLE is skipped.

evidence.observed: ezdxf exposes a limited read_acad_table_content helper returning strings and documents limited preservation with no native ACAD_TABLE creation/content editing. TablePainter renders a table using ordinary DXF primitives and is not an ACAD_TABLE entity writer.
evidence.planUse: Use ezdxf only for the narrow parsed-cell-text projection when the exact content profile is supported. Keep raw tag/graph checks and native rendering separate; never count TablePainter output as ACAD_TABLE serialization.

evidence.observed: Current documentation says FreeCAD does not directly read/write DWG and relies on external converters. Its DWG wrapper converts to DXF, then invokes the selected DXF importer; the C++ importer records independent import options such as dxfScaling and annotation/layout behavior.
evidence.planUse: A composed native result must bind converter and intermediate DXF separately from importer backend/options and final document/table ownership. A converter exit or document open does not qualify DWG table semantics.

implementationReadiness.existingOwnerOnly: 7G.3d / PAR-20; no new finding or top-level subplan
implementationReadiness.firstLocalCheck: Inventory already-tracked AC1021 and AC1024 DWGs; record hash, AC code, exact TABLE/TABLESTYLE oType and handle/owner/style path. Read the ODA object chapter before changing any parseDwg/dispatch and empirically capture the actual oType from a real sample trace.
parserAssertions: rows and columns are bounded and consistent with staged cell count
cell type and text/block reference survive
row heights, column widths, merge spans and top-left span values are retained
title/header suppression and style override states are preserved or explicitly refused
style/owner/block references resolve uniquely and cursor reaches the following object
unsupported or malformed tables do not publish a partial successful callback
writerAssertions: ACAD_TABLE entity and *T backing block are emitted once
group 342 TABLESTYLE and group 343 owning BLOCK_RECORD target emitted identities
cell matrix, merged ranges and supported overrides match literal expected tags
owner graph and per-source disposition match the emitted-object inventory
unsupported tables fail before atomic publication and preserve existing destination
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: Affected strict build plus one focused generated test per slice. Run the composed ASCII/binary and supported-version set once after graph closure; schedule one native consumer/render check only after parser, adapter, serializer and graph gates pass.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: Use existing tracked drawings or locally generated in-memory controls. Add no downloaded/customer test DWG/DXF, dependency or CTest registration in this research update.
